source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Storage drive information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Data should be readable and correct.
2. Check the every storage drive status is fit actual status
3. Check storage FW ver is correct

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X GET https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Systems/system/Storage | jq .Drives | map(.Name+":"+(.SerialNumber//"")+" fw "+(.Revision//""))
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Systems/system/Storage (storage drive details) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "Storage Drive details". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes a flat `.Drives` array, concatenates only name/serial/revision, weakens TLS and can miss controller-linked members, topology, capacity, health, protocol and nullable-field semantics.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires complete controller/drive traversal, per-slot identity/status/health/capacity/firmware and a no-storage-mutation boundary.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 971/2291 accepts the flat serial/version list as direct evidence.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The next RAID/HBA controller case validates controllers, not each drive; neither aggregate storage nor controller evidence substitutes for per-drive coverage.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves WebUI evidence; ED-34 permits approved read-only collectors; ED-35 prevents three-field coverage reduction; ED-36 treats topology/firmware matrix as readiness; destructive storage actions remain excluded.

original_test_intent: Verify every storage drive's BMC detail, actual status and firmware version are readable and correct.
original_method: Traverse all storage controllers and drive links, map each drive to enclosure/slot, collect protected read-only identity, protocol, media, capacity, state, health and firmware, and compare with WebUI and the approved storage/firmware matrix without rescans or mutation.
manual_activity: The owner supplies controller/enclosure/slot topology, expected population and firmware/health rules. The agent may collect protected inventory; slot discrepancies and final verdict remain engineer-owned.
safety_requirements: Do not rescan, format, erase, replace, update drive firmware, power-cycle or reset.
Do not assume Storage.Drives is a complete flat collection.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Redact serial/WWN while retaining stable correlation IDs.
Stop on ambiguous slot, stale health or incomplete traversal without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the exact ComputerSystem and all Storage controller/drive links/pages.
Map each drive to controller, enclosure and physical slot.
Correlate every drive with WebUI and Project matrix.
Return evidence only with storage state unchanged.
engineer_actions: Approve topology, expected population and identifier redaction.
Review mismatches and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial and schema-fragile: a flat Name/Serial/Revision list cannot establish complete slot coverage, capacity, protocol, health, actual status or protected evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Traverse every controller and drive member link, normalize complete per-drive fields and compare by approved physical slot with identifiers redacted.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Storage Drive details, WebUI method, three Criteria and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform complete topology-bound per-drive read-only inventory/status/firmware reconciliation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected system's storage controllers, enclosures and populated slots.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, Redfish Storage schema and parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor storage topology and Project drive/firmware matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds linked collection traversal, physical slot binding, complete fields and privacy/safety controls while retaining WebUI comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Name, serial and revision alone cannot prove complete population, physical mapping, health, capacity, protocol or actual status.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Storage topology, expected drive matrix and accepted firmware/health semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Stale management status or wrong slot mapping can hide a failed/misplaced drive; mutation could cause outage or data loss and is excluded.

project_override_considerations: Alternate read-only tools require exact per-slot identity and equivalent state/health/firmware coverage, engineer approval and explicit accounting for uncovered WebUI/Redfish paths.
expected_evidence: Complete controller/drive link inventory and slot map

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requires every drive's details/status/firmware; the flat DeepSeek list is incomplete implementation, not a competing purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The per-drive inventory objective is clear; topology, expected population and firmware values are Project readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds full link traversal, physical slots, health/capacity/protocol and protected identifiers.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and no-storage-mutation boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Rejects direct acceptance of schema-fragile three-field output.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Separates per-drive evidence from controller-level coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents a partial serial/version list from hiding missing, misplaced, degraded or wrongly sized drives and makes data-loss boundaries explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Redfish Storage models may expose controllers and drives through links rather than one flat property. Correctness is per physical slot and includes live health plus firmware against the approved population; stable redacted correlation is needed, and no inventory check authorizes rescan, format, erase or firmware update.
